name: com.flightvision.dronevision
description: Body control for the drone-operator game, the same logic as the PC app (Mashk drone): the player raises both hands like wings; tilting them turns left / right (keys A / D), both wrists above / below the shoulder line flies up / down (W / S). A green frame confirms the player first. All logic runs in C# (WebAssembly in WebGL builds). Read README.md (English, for developers and AI assistants) or README.fa.md (Persian).

samples.description: DroneVisionExample: flies a transform with the wings (keys or analog), pauses when the player is lost. DroneVisionDebugHUD: on-screen status readout (F1).
